import numpy as np
import random

# Set seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(17)
random.seed(17)

# Generate G(200, 0.3) graph
n = 200
p = 0.3
edges = []

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))

# Create adjacency list representation
adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for i, j in edges:
    adj[i].append(j)
    adj[j].append(i)

# Start with a random partition
partition = [random.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]

# Local search improvement
def count_cut_edges(partition, adj):
    cut = 0
    for i in range(len(partition)):
        for j in adj[i]:
            if i < j and partition[i] != partition[j]:
                cut += 1
    return cut

# Iteratively improve the partition
max_iterations = 1000
current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)

for iteration in range(max_iterations):
    improved = False
    for v in range(n):
        # Try flipping vertex v
        old_label = partition[v]
        partition[v] = 1 - old_label
        new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj)
        
        if new_cut > current_cut:
            current_cut = new_cut
            improved = True
        else:
            partition[v] = old_label
    
    if not improved:
        break

# Additional multi-start approach for better solution
best_partition = partition[:]
best_cut = current_cut

for restart in range(50):
    # Random restart
    test_partition = [random.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]
    test_cut = count_cut_edges(test_partition, adj)
    
    # Local improvement
    for iteration in range(200):
        improved = False
        for v in range(n):
            old_label = test_partition[v]
            test_partition[v] = 1 - old_label
            new_cut = count_cut_edges(test_partition, adj)
            
            if new_cut > test_cut:
                test_cut = new_cut
                improved = True
            else:
                test_partition[v] = old_label
        
        if not improved:
            break
    
    if test_cut > best_cut:
        best_cut = test_cut
        best_partition = test_partition[:]
